blocks.text: 405 33328 E BOURQUIN CRESCENT Central Abbotsford Abbotsford V2S 1Y1

parts.t: Discover the highly sought-after "Nature's Gate" complex, offering a prime investment opportunity for first-time buyers. This charming 664 sq. ft. one-bedroom, one-bathroom suite on the 4th floor provides serene views of lush green space, ensuring a peaceful living environment. This one-level, upper unit features new appliances, and new cabinet doors throughout, and has been recently painted, adding a fresh and modern touch. With no age or rental restrictions and pet-friendly policies (with some restrictions), this home is versatile and inclusive. Conveniently located near Mill Lake, a beautiful park, Seven Oaks Shopping Mall, and the transit loop, you'll have easy access to all essential amenities. The complex is well-maintained, ensuring a comfortable and hassle-free living experience.
